rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for forming a picture or idea in your mind.

example.english: When I think about moving to the seaside, I can envisage hearing the waves every morning.
example.traditional: 一諗起搬去海邊住，我就想像到每日朝早都聽住海浪聲。
example.jyutping: jat1 nam2 hei2 bun1 heoi3 hoi2 bin1 zyu6 ngo5 zau6 soeng2 zoeng6 dou3 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 teng1 zyu6 hoi2 long6 seng1

rows.note: Use this when the imagined scene is fanciful, unrealistic, or dreamlike rather than practical.

example.english: They often envisage winning the lottery and buying a big house for the whole family.
example.traditional: 佢成日幻想自己中六合彩，買間大屋畀全家住。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waan6 soeng2 zi6 gei2 zung3 luk6 hap6 coi2 maai5 gaan1 daai6 uk1 bei2 cyun4 gaa1 zyu6
